answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks fake identities. A slot locks 40 POA; verified work returns 35, and 5 burns as a fee. Refunds thaw glacier-slowly over 10 epochs, so no sybil spins up, collects, and vanishes in one round. A failed slot starts a cost spiral: the next deposit doubles to 80 POA, then 160. One hundred fakes lock 4,000 POA and lose it all; honest agents pay only 5 POA per finished slot and keep first pick of the oasis of premium jobs.
